::: {#exm-euler-examples}
#### An Euler circuit and an Euler trail

In the graph $T$ of @fig-triangles,

$$
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 5, 3, 1
$$

is an Euler circuit (@def-euler-circuit):
it is a circuit that goes from 1 to 5 along two edges of the left triangle and two edges of the middle triangle,
around the whole right triangle back to 5,
and back to 1 along the third edge of the middle triangle and the third edge of the left triangle,
so it uses each of the nine edges once.

The walk $v, w, x, v, y, x, z, y, w$ of @sol-envelope is an Euler trail (@def-euler-trail) from $v$ to $w$ of the envelope graph.

:::
